description: This Java class 'NoteService' provides CRUD operations for managing notes within a backend service layer, using Spring annotations for transaction management and dependency injection.

classes.name: NoteService
classes.description: Service layer class managing CRUD operations for notes.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new note from the provided request object.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all notes.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a specific note by its ID.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing note based on ID and request data.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a note by its ID.
